commands.authority: These are private native fixture controls, never packaged/H/S/P/J or per-case authority. Existing native mode/channel/inherited packaged-pin refusal applies before effects.
commands.fixed_actor_executable: Same current_exe(), no arbitrary path/script/argv/PATH input
commands.unit_child: Same current_exe() of externally hash-bound reposync_core libtest, --exact same full reviewed leaf --nocapture --test-threads=1 --format pretty --color never; exact one matching passing row and1passed0failed0ignored summary required.

source_timing.blocking_limit: Spawn, locks, stdout/stderr/IPC writes, filesystem/procfs and output() can stall. Checks/timeouts do not supply an end-to-end finite wall clock, aggregate resource quota, or confirmed cleanup after cancellation.
source_timing.outer_output: Command::output waits for exit and EOF; post-spawn observation errors have unknown stage and no explicit retained child/PID owner in the driver. Preserve scratch/UNKNOWN; native provider step/process-tree cancellation/freshVM containment admission is still required.
source_timing.sequential_composition: Anchored startup has anchor-control, primary-initial-control and primary-scenario-control invocations. Reaped-leader startup adds its own descendant handshake. Primary collection, anchor collection and group observation each start separate budgets. The two primary IPC phases may each wait15s. No field is a cumulative3s or per-process15s overall bound.

exclusive_wait_ownership.substantive_precondition: No competing waiter may reap the registered group-leader anchor before all signal-capable calls return. DefaultSIGCHLD alone is not proof of this.
exclusive_wait_ownership.proposed_closed_topology: Each provider step starts a fresh exact-one-case libtest process with one test thread under env-i. The sole selected helper spawns one exact isolated unit process. That unit alone owns its anchor/primary Children in the typed resource registry. Only this case executes; no service, scheduler, background test or generic child-reaper is started.
exclusive_wait_ownership.wait_roles: Outer driver waits only for its direct isolated-unit Child. Anchor/primary waits occur only through their source-owned Child records; actor roles use original IPC. The source registry is context/type scoped; signal-capable calls hold the actual exclusively unreaped group-leader Child synchronously and revoke before any anchor reap. No collector signal, legacy redispatch or numeric revalidation may grant authority.
exclusive_wait_ownership.read_only_runtime_admission: Source require_native() checks actual defaultSIGCHLD and absenceSA_NOCLDWAIT before all native entry effects; it refuses without changing policy. No inherited preloader, packaged channel, private test/fixture marker, launcher, signal-disposition change, competing-waiter utility or shell command is passed in the env-i allowlist.
exclusive_wait_ownership.limits: Source/metadata review must assess the closed execution call graph, not infer exclusive wait ownership from runner label, no observed processes, procfs or the signal query. Kernel stalls/SIGKILL/loss of Drop remain external containment obligations.
exclusive_wait_ownership.inspection: The only other repository waitpid occurrence is in a different unselected process.rs test; none is selected by this profile. This text inspection is not a host process probe or serving-image attestation.

native_child_protocol.IPC_FD_contract: Source fixed current_exe actor argv plus enum scenario/role and original UnixStream endpoints; only its owned ready/release descriptors have FD_CLOEXEC adjusted in the spawned child. No arbitrary executable/PATH/script or external FD injection.
native_child_protocol.retention: Physical ContainmentRecord never finishes case/resource/error ownership. Reaped/revoked authority stays unusable; wrong-role checked stop cannot redispatch. Unknown collection retains evidence.
native_child_protocol.external_containment: Native GitHub step/job cancellation and fresh disposable VM containment cover the driver, isolated child, anchor, primary and same-group descendant. No custom supervisor or job-local PGID snapshot is substituted.
